name: verbs_stealth_kill
about: The stealth kill (stealth.md 'Stealth-kill transaction (RE50)'). An idle neutral Troika human on the east pad faces the room's middle; the player stands 85 cm (33 units) straight behind it, crouched, a knife wielded (granted by player.armed and wielded by the melee-category verb slot2; item_w_fists is 'weapon_melee hidden' and is not offered by the selector), unseen and unheard. +use at 2 s (and, as the second door, +attack at 4 s: the melee primary 0x103eaca0 calls the stealth thunk at 0x103ead0b before its own swing): PlayerUse 0x10167850 -> PlayerTryStealthKill 0x10167370 -> CStealthKillRules::FindVictim 0x101be1f0: the posture (FL_DUCKING), the melee weapon byte (CWeaponMelee 0x103e9ac0 writes +0x872 = 1), the forward MASK_PLAYERSOLID trace over StealthKillDistMax (70) hits the victim, IsValidStealthKillTarget 0x102c2300 passes (not hidden, no dialogname, not invincible, not dead under debug_allow_non_idle_auto_sk '1', neither HEAR_PLAYER 0x6f nor SEE_PLAYER 0x5a, alive), InDeafArc 0x101be500 passes (dot 1.0 behind), CanStartGrappleAttack(type 3) passes: the query admits the mark (trace kind stealthkill, `arena_mark admit gate=can_grapple`); the probes at 1.5 s read the posture and the wielded knife it needs. StartGrappleAttack 0x10328df0 locks both into grapple mode 3 (the NPC's grapple entry 0x1026cdc0 -> 0x1026d130 clears its enemy and raises m_iIsOblivious, so it senses nothing more); the attacker's paired clip finishing enters 0x10165d90, which copies Max_Health into the damage-taken stat and calls Event_Killed directly (slot 144): the synchronized death, OnDeath, the corpse -- the same chain as an ordinary kill from slot 144 on (CBaseCombatCharacter::Event_Killed 0x1032b9b0 -> slot 301 CreateCorpse 0x1032c0e0 -> BecomeClientRagdoll 0x10090180: the pose handed to physics, the drawn body on the floor; stories/v4/brief-D-ragdoll.md § 'What retail does').
notes: V4d measured solid-local-source-bone-v1 / ragdoll-v1, 15 authored convex bodies / 14 joints, real admission sim=1. Headless fixed-60-Hz regular_cop pelvis rest: scalar death 18.138 cm (stable under 5 cm/s from t=5.6), paired stealth death 17.016 cm (stable under 5 from t=6.4). Shared 20 cm asset-specific bound leaves 1.862 cm margin over the higher measured rest; no limit or hull enlarged. Both deaths consume the weighted pick but retain the current real-bone pose. Death/OnDeath/corpse occur once on the kill tick, no movement/tasks/schedules follow death. Direct arena_mark regular_cop, spawnflags4, knife/crouch behind; no fade child or timing change. Final floor/rest query stays at t=20. The earlier green held paired pose has now been replaced by positively observed simulation and a settling series.
